# Overdue Kit

> Overdue Kit helps freelancers and small agencies get an overdue business invoice paid. It works out the statutory late payment interest and fixed compensation that EU and UK law give businesses, and writes 5 dated letters, from a friendly reminder to a final notice and a payment plan offer.

- Free: the calculator (EU and UK rules, rate filled in for checked countries) and letter 1. No account. Invoice data stays in the browser.
- Paid: letters 2 to 5, a calendar file with every send date and a print layout. EUR 19, paid once, through PayPal. 14-day refund on request.
- Scope: business-to-business invoices. Not for private consumers. Templates and calculations, not legal advice.
- Maker: an independent maker in Germany (see the imprint).

## Product

- [Overdue Kit, free calculator and letters](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/): enter the invoice, get the interest, compensation and send dates.
- [Reference rates (JSON)](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/rates.json): ECB, Bank of England and Bundesbank rates, refreshed weekly.
- [EU country rules (JSON)](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/eu-countries.json): statutory margin and official source per EU country.

## Guides

- [Overdue invoice guides: late payment interest and letters](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/): hub page that lists every guide.
- [EU late payment interest rate 2026: the B2B rule by country](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/eu-late-payment-interest.html): EU minimum: ECB reference rate plus 8 points (10,4% now), EUR 40, table for all 27 countries.
- [UK late payment interest: 8% plus base rate (11,75% now)](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/uk-late-payment-interest.html): UK: 8% plus base rate (11,75% now), GBP 40 / 70 / 100, base rate history.
- [Germany late payment interest: base rate + 9 (10,52% now)](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/germany-late-payment-interest.html): Germany: Basiszinssatz plus 9 points (10,52% now), rates since 2024.
- [Late payment interest 10,4%: Ireland, Netherlands, Spain, Italy](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/euro-countries-late-payment-interest.html): 8 countries on ECB plus 8 (10,4% now): Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Slovenia, Spain.
- [Late payment interest: Austria, Poland, Sweden and 3 more](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/national-rate-countries-late-payment-interest.html): Austria, Finland, Hungary, Poland, Slovakia, Sweden: rule and source per country.
- [EUR 40 late payment compensation: EU and UK fixed sums](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/late-payment-compensation-eur-40.html): Fixed compensation per late invoice: EUR 40 (EU), GBP 40 / 70 / 100 (UK).
- [How to calculate late payment interest (EU and UK formula)](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/how-to-calculate-late-payment-interest.html): The formula, step by step, with a worked example.
- [Friendly payment reminder email for an overdue invoice](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/friendly-payment-reminder-letter.html): Letter 1: friendly reminder, 3 days after the due date. Free.
- [Second payment reminder with a 7-day deadline: what to write](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/firm-payment-reminder-with-deadline.html): Letter 2: firm reminder with a 7-day deadline, 7 days after letter 1.
- [Formal notice letter claiming late payment interest](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/formal-notice-late-payment-interest.html): Letter 3: formal notice claiming interest and compensation, 14 days after letter 1.
- [Final notice before legal action: unpaid invoice letter](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/final-notice-before-legal-action.html): Letter 4: final notice before further action, 21 days after letter 1.
- [Payment plan offer letter for an unpaid invoice (3 instalments)](https://overdue.toolkitsdesk.com/guides/payment-plan-offer-letter.html): Letter 5: payment plan offer in 3 instalments, when they cannot pay in full.

Rates as stored on 2026-10-11.
